title: action.executed
description: PAYLOAD of the `action.executed` envelope. Topic: activation.action_plan.executed. Emitted by the Action Executor (§10.2) after it actually performed a SIGNED ActionPlan's connector mutation(s) via the Temporal LaunchSaga (with compensation — a half-failed launch is paused+tagged, never left half-live spending). Carries the platform ids written + the outcome. The executor is the ONLY component allowed to call connector mutations (P4). result=failed|rolled_back here doubles for the spec's action.plan.failed/rolled_back so the single executed event carries terminal outcome (extend-never-mutate §6.2).

action_plan_id.description: The signed ActionPlan that was executed.

result.description: Terminal outcome of execution. executed = mutation applied; failed = mutation failed (no live state change); rolled_back = compensation ran (e.g. orphan ad set paused) (§10.2).

action_type.description: Echo of what was done (from the plan) for downstream routing without loading the plan.

platform_refs_written.description: Platform entity ids created/changed by this execution (§10.2 writes platform ids). For a launch this matches campaign.launched.platform_refs.

idempotency_key.description: The exactly-once key the executor used against the connector (P3 — every external mutation carries one; replay-safe).

compensation.description: Present when result=rolled_back: what the saga compensated (§10.2 'adset fails -> pause+tag orphan, never half-live spend').

error.description: Present when result=failed: machine-readable failure (e.g. Meta error code 17/4/613, §5.3 backoff).
